description: This Java source file defines the ProductAttributeController class, which manages CRUD operations and interactions for product attributes within an administrative web interface. It handles listing, editing, creating, saving, and deleting product attributes, as well as retrieving attribute types, associated with products in an e-commerce platform.

classes.name: ProductAttributeController
classes.description: Controller managing product attribute operations in admin interface.

methods.name: displayProductAttributes
methods.description: Displays the list of attributes for a specific product.

methods.name: pageAttributes
methods.description: Handles AJAX pagination requests for product attributes.

methods.name: displayAttributeEdit
methods.description: Shows the form for editing a product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttributeCreate
methods.description: Shows the form for creating a new product attribute.

methods.name: displayAttribute
methods.description: Private method to prepare attribute detail view with data for editing or creating.

methods.name: saveAttribute
methods.description: Validates and saves a product attribute, handling both creation and update.

methods.name: deleteProductPrice
methods.description: Deletes a product attribute based on the provided ID.

methods.name: checkAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves and confirms the type of a product option.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the navigation menu context for the admin interface.
